FX-CLINK-001.says: The settings as added: the layer's own picture, average, clip 5, stencil off, opacity 100, normal: the whole layer, its empty column too, one colour, the clipped average of its own colours.

FX-CLINK-002.says: Source layer `swatch`, hidden: the layer turns the swatch's average colour, warm at frame 0 and cold at frame 3 when the swatch's drawing changes.

FX-CLINK-004.says: Sample brightest: the colour of the swatch's brightest pixels, the top 5 per cent clipped.

FX-CLINK-006.says: Sample max RGB: each channel's own highest, 5 per cent clipped.

FX-CLINK-008.says: Average with clip 0: every pixel of the swatch counted.

FX-CLINK-009.says: Stencil on: the colour only where the layer shows; the empty column stays empty and the half-covered one stays half covered.

FX-CLINK-010.says: Opacity 50, stencil on: halfway from the drawing to the colour.

FX-CLINK-011.says: Opacity 50, stencil off: the drawing halfway to the colour, and the empty column the colour at half covering.

FX-CLINK-012.says: Blending mode multiply, opacity 50, stencil on.

FX-CLINK-013.says: Blending mode screen, opacity 50, stencil on.

FX-CLINK-014.says: Blending mode add, opacity 50, stencil on.

FX-CLINK-015.says: Blending mode overlay, opacity 100, stencil on: the drawing keeps its light and dark, coloured by the swatch.

FX-CLINK-016.says: Blending mode soft light, opacity 100, stencil off: the empty column the plain colour, the rest softly tinted.

FX-CLINK-017.says: Opacity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear, stencil on: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 halfway, frame 4 the swatch's cold colour.

FX-CLINK-018.says: Source layer `big`, 20 by 12, bigger than the holder: read whole, so its magenta border counts and pulls the average toward magenta.

FX-CLINK-019.says: Source layer `ghost`, not a layer of the composition: the layer as it is, with EFFECT_LAYER_MISSING each frame.

FX-CLINK-020.says: Clip 50, above 49. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CLINK-021.says: Opacity -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CLINK-022.says: Sample "mean", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CLINK-023.says: Stencil "yes", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CLINK-024.says: Blending mode "color_dodge", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CLINK-025.says: Blending mode "Normal": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
